verdict.rationale: Algolia ships an official CLI for working with its APIs from the terminal. It supports scripts and CI workflows, browser-based auth, application management commands, and macOS/Linux/Windows on AMD64/ARM64. An official agent skill (`algolia-cli`) lets AI agents manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms through it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's use in agentic workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Algolia CLI lets you work with Algolia's APIs from your terminal. It's great for interactive commands, scripts, and continuous integration workflows.
`algolia-cli` Manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms via the Algolia CLI
The CLI runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, on both AMD64 and ARM64 platforms.
algolia application list     # list your applications
